name: nujabes_night
descriptor_pool: Late Night Lofi Hip Hop for Study & Sleep
Mellow Lofi for Reading After Midnight
Soft Lofi Beats to End the Day
intro: The library is closed, but one lamp is still on. Dust drifts through the light, a record turns, and the rest of the world goes quiet enough to hear it.
features: Felt piano and dusty Rhodes chords, played slow
Boom-bap drums sampled from old vinyl, warm and unhurried
Upright bass holding the low end together
Ideal for studying after midnight, reading, or falling asleep
immersion: No vocals, no drops, nothing that asks for your attention. Just thirty-six quiet rooms you can walk into one after another.
sip: Turn the lamp down a little. Let the night keep you company.
question: Where do you usually listen — desk, couch, or bed?
subscribe: Subscribe for more long-form lofi mixes every week.
